excerpt: FULL-GENERIC-ESSENCE Being F is what it is to be G in full iff: for a thing to be G is for it to be F (in symbols: Gx ºx Fx).
overview: This definition is a compact formal artifact for the essence side of the account. It identifies full generic essence with generalized identity, making essence a matter of what it is for something to satisfy a predicate rather than a merely modal necessity claim.
title: Full Essence Formula
